answer: Best mechanism: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. A verifiable random function draws each epoch's jury from all agents, so no fixed jury exists. Payouts follow panel consensus; proven collusion slashes stakes. An attacker cannot know who grades whom, so each sybil costs a staked bond plus honest work, and bought votes rarely land on the right panels - a fable fox bribing a jury it cannot name. Collusion is planting lies in a garden you do not own: costly seeds, random harvest, uprooted if caught. The quill of record rewards only honest contribution.
